primitive.relation: two contracts under the corpus name "spanning_tree", sharing only the name. LABELLED simple graphs (canonical GTBase.spanning_trees.fg_spanning_tree, B18): X167.x167_spanning_tree and X168.x168_spanning_tree (T \subset fg_edges G /\ is_tree [set: fg_labelled_sgraph T]: a set of valid edges of G whose labelled graph on the WHOLE vertex carrier of G, isolated vertices included, is an upstream tree) are fg_spanning_tree T by conversion; the subset guard stays part of the contract (the labelled-graph constructor drops only malformed members and keeps every two-element member, so host non-edges are excluded by the guard alone), host connectivity follows, and the conventions are derived from upstream is_tree: the empty edge set spans 'K_0 (vacuously) and 'K_1, the single edge spans 'K_2, the triangle's full edge set, any disconnected host and any host with at least two vertices one of which is isolated are rejected. MULTIGRAPH edge carriers (canonical Cycle.foundations.spanning_trees.spanning_tree_edge_set over Cycle.foundations.connectivity and path_subgraphs, B19): Cycle.U6.spanning_tree (spanning_connected T /\ acyclic T: an undirected uwalk inside T between every two HOST vertices, and no circuit inside T) is spanning_tree_edge_set T by conversion, the conjunction of the all-host-vertex restricted walk spanning_connected_edge_set and the public acyclic_edge_set; U6's unchanged supports spanning_connected and acyclic are frozen as copies but not migrated. Conventions: the empty host and the empty carrier are accepted vacuously, one vertex with the empty carrier is accepted beside an unselected loop, a single non-loop edge spans its two-vertex host in either reference orientation, a third isolated vertex defeats spanning connectivity although the carrier stays connected on its incident support, and a selected loop, parallel pair or digon is rejected; no loopless, simplicity, nonempty-carrier or nonempty-host guard is added. No equivalence between the two representations is stated. Not sources of this family: the whole-graph tree wrappers of XE1 (definitionally is_tree), D2tur.tree_on / shortest_tree_on, U9.tree_contains_T, the directed trees of P9 / X2 and B9's path_tree.

labelled-edge-spanning-tree.note: T \subset fg_edges G /\ is_tree [set: fg_labelled_sgraph T]: the body of fg_spanning_tree T, convertible. Their chains are frozen complete: the five-field Records x167/x168_extension_system (auxiliary dimension, inequality index, its cardinality bound, and the two linking fields concluding True, the documented defect of both BLOCKED rows, kept literal) with explicit witness transports in both directions, the existence wrappers, the two rows with every guard in order, and the complete C11+B18 X168 Original over C11's frozen minor-class body.

multigraph-edge-carrier.note: Cycle U6's spanning_tree T := spanning_connected T /\ acyclic T on an mgraph edge set: an edge CARRIER of an undirected multigraph, every two HOST vertices joined by an undirected uwalk inside T (isolated host vertices therefore excluded when the host has at least two vertices; not the incident-support connectivity subgraph_connected) and no circuit inside T (a selected loop or parallel pair is a circuit). It is the body of the canonical Cycle.foundations.spanning_trees.spanning_tree_edge_set (B19), convertible: spanning_connected_edge_set /\ acyclic_edge_set (Cycle.foundations.path_subgraphs). A different representation from the labelled simple-graph class, sharing only the corpus name. Its row three_decomposition_statement (opg:3_decomposition_conjecture) is frozen complete with every guard and the T/F/M order, together with the complete A13+B19 Original over A13's frozen arc-end cubic; the unchanged supports spanning_connected and acyclic are frozen as historical copies and stay live, unmigrated helpers.

upstream_audit.note: coq-graph-theory has is_forest, is_tree, is_forestb, connectedb, forestI, forest3 and connected_card_gt1 over a vertex set of an sgraph, and the complete graphs 'K_n, but no spanning-tree predicate for a labelled edge set; GTBase.finite_graph owns fg_edges, fg_labelled_sgraph and the bridge fg_edgesE : fg_edges G = E(G). The new public GTBase.spanning_trees is the focused adapter: fg_spanning_tree with its Boolean form and reflection, the subset / tree / forest / connectivity projections and introduction, the E(G) form, edge validity (every member is a pair of adjacent vertices), whole-carrier covering, host connectivity, and the groundings on 'K_0, 'K_1, 'K_2, the triangle, a missing vertex, two isolated vertices and a singleton member. Not re-exported by GTBase.base; X167 and X168 import it explicitly. No forest or graph constructor is added. B19 (multigraph contract): the pinned coq-graph-theory sources have no spanning-tree predicate over an mgraph edge carrier; base owns uwalk, Cycle.foundations.connectivity owns mconnected, walk_in, is_circuit and subgraph_connected (incident-support connectivity, insufficient for spanning), and Cycle.foundations.path_subgraphs owns acyclic_edge_set, is_circuit_loop and is_circuit_parallel. The new public Cycle.foundations.spanning_trees is the focused adapter: spanning_connected_edge_set (all-host-vertex restricted uwalk, with its walk_in form), spanning_tree_edge_set, projections, introduction, host connectivity, the loop/parallel rejections and the groundings (empty host, one vertex beside a loop, one edge in either orientation, a third isolated vertex, a parallel pair, a digon). GTBase cannot import Cycle, so this canonical stays in cycle-theory beside the GTBase anchor of the labelled contract.
